issues.description: After logging in via the SwiftRoute workspace link, the dashboard shows "Unknown Workspace" instead of the company name. The OidcCallbackPage does not populate the tenant_slug/tenant_display_name in the session, so the workspace header has no company context.

The onboarding pipeline test fills the display_name field with a generated placeholder ("Pipeline Tenant e8587d2a") instead of the scenario value ("SwiftRoute Ltd"). The ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_DISPLAY_NAME env var is not supported by the pipeline test.
